name: claudeconnect
notes: A new look, matching ChatGPT as it is now: black in dark (white in light) with the site's name at the top of the sidebar, Recents, a Chat | Files switch at the top, the model and effort in the message box, and the blue send button.

Update available shows on the site again. The site now checks for new versions reliably every minute, also asks GitHub another way when the usual one is turned away, and your computer tells the site about a new version too.
The free plan is gone: your site always answers using your paid plan. Settings and setup no longer ask which plan you have, and the desktop app is no longer used.

A file browser (Files in the sidebar, the Chat | Files switch at the top, or Settings → Files), full screen. It reaches everything your site can: the working folder, your home folder with its Desktop, Documents and Downloads, other folders it's allowed into, and the whole computer. Look at photos, play audio and video, and download anything.

Text and code files can be edited right in the file browser and saved to your computer (Ctrl+S or ⌘S works too), keeping their line endings. If the file changed on your computer meanwhile, it asks before saving over it.
Move to Trash sends a file or folder to the Trash on your computer (the Recycle Bin on Windows), so it can always be put back.
A file the reply writes has Show in file browser in its preview, which opens the file browser right at that file.
What you type but haven't sent is kept for each chat, in your browser: switching chats, reloading or closing the page doesn't lose it.
The tab title, the text next to the tab icon in the browser, can be set on its own in Settings → Appearance (and with edit). Empty, it's the site's name.
The command on your computer is always the site's name now: renaming the site renames the command to match.
